set.body: Scope: add end-to-end LNA and NeuroArchive Zarr source-blind read scenarios; add a cross-session coordinate/window -> segmented -> block-concatenated scenario; synchronize module READMEs and docs/module-relations; audit the public surface against the normative plan and reject duplicate LoadError/FmriAcquisition/handle-capability/study-index/parallel-selection algebras. Acceptance: dataset JVM+JS, dataset-zarr JVM+JS, model JVM+JS, fit JVM+JS, mvpa-dataset JVM+JS, and group JVM+JS gates pass; testAll is run at exact tip or any environment/pre-existing failure is isolated honestly; warning-clean build and scenario receipts are recorded; the epic closes only after every child is complete.
set.title: Bridge E: scenarios, downstream gates, and release audit
